note: AM-29's QAT epoch rules (lane L-AM29, P3): the nine AM-29 arms (src/quant/am29.py ARMS), which run AM-4a item 1's recipe with the allow-list's factor, rate and seed. Read by scripts/am29_blockb.py select through src/quant/qat_select.py load_rules, the file registered for AM-29's stages in that process only (src/quant/am29_registry.py), which refuses a disagreement. The qat_epoch block is configs/qat_selection_rules_am23.json's but for stages, source and value: every converted epoch is scored all-INT8 through src/eval/am29_score.py (the evaluator's own loading, preprocessing and metric code; scripts/evaluate_model.py cannot take an AM-29 stage). The clip is configs/qat_selection_rules.json's U4 winner (AM-4a item 3; DL-139), so this file holds no qat_clip block.

qat_epoch.source: AM-29 (P3); AM-4; AM-4a item 2; AM-21 item 2(a); DL-09; DL-38; DL-139
qat_epoch.value: dataset_level.all_class_miou of the epoch's converted all-INT8 QNNPACK TorchScript artifact, scored on VAL by src/eval/am29_score.py score_model
qat_epoch.excluded: an epoch whose checkpoint fails item 1(a): excluded: non-finite state (AM-21 item 2(a))
